ex.en: He bought a new PC to play games and edit videos.
ex.zh: 他買了一台新的個人電腦來玩遊戲和剪輯影片。

ex.en: My old PC takes a long time to start up.
ex.zh: 我的舊電腦開機要很久。

ex.en: Some people think it is not PC to joke about that topic.
ex.zh: 有些人認為拿那個話題開玩笑不夠政治正確。

ex.en: The company tries to use PC language in its advertisements.
ex.zh: 這間公司在廣告中試著使用政治正確的用語。
